purpose: Illustrative SITE-style camera references for ADR 0003, not runtime art or geometry acceptance.

default.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: polished landscape game-screen reference accompanying an architecture decision, 16:9 desktop frame.
Input images: reference 1 is the original Moles Under the Pitch SITE portal and supplies the UI art direction; reference 2 is the site's brand palette and pixel logo system; reference 3 supplies the bold adult fantasy-athlete pixel rendering style. They are style references. Design a NEW match pitch screen, not a sign-in page.
Primary request: DEFAULT END-ON PERSPECTIVE coach view. Elevated camera about 55 degrees above the ground, straight along the long axis, ZERO diagonal yaw, from the near home half toward the distant away half. The field is a trapezoid: near width wider, far width narrower, both sidelines fully on screen. Visible playable field fills about 85% of the screen. Length extends vertically beyond the framing, suggesting vertical camera pan; focus around midfield. Do not draw a whole-pitch diamond or overhead field.
Art: crisp high-detail PIXEL ART matching SITE reference, connected pixel clusters, bold dark edges, layered green turf, gently worn chalk square grid, compact adult fantasy-football athletes. Home humans wear navy/cyan/ivory with brown leather and steel; away orcs wear charcoal/rust/gold and olive skin. Show a representative 11-versus-11 formation around midfield, home closer and away further. Athletes stand upright above their square bases; slightly larger near players and smaller distant players. One reddish-brown elongated American football with laces. Original modest timber/stone fantasy stadium at the edges, original tiny mole emblem on midfield. No existing game-company logos.
UI art direction: SITE's restrained dark navy, cyan highlights, gold key actions, rust team contrast, off-white readable labels; square edged pixel-style frames, small pixel display headings and clean small labels. DO NOT use the current MVP pitch's ornate serif typography, brown parchment, oversized sidebars or brass medieval chrome.
Transparency: slim top scoreboard and corner panels use translucent navy glass at roughly 60-70% opacity with visible grass/grid/players behind them, opaque crisp light lettering and cyan/gold outlines. Panels should float over pitch, not reduce its width. Slightly denser backing immediately behind text. No frosted blur; preserve pixel clarity.
Layout: small upper-left mole brand and 'MOLES UNDER THE PITCH'; compact centered scoreboard 'IRONBANK ROVERS  1 - 0  CINDERCLAW CREW' and 'HALF 1 · TURN 4'; narrow upper-right 'HOME VIEW'. Bottom-left compact selected-player card 'ALDEN · BLITZER' with 'MA 6  ST 3  AG 3+  AV 9+'. Bottom-center thin floating action strip 'MOVE' 'BLOCK' 'BLITZ' 'PASS' 'END TURN', selected MOVE in cyan and END TURN in gold. Bottom-right small translucent event log with 'Alden selected' and 'Choose a destination'. Tiny offscreen-navigation chevrons near the lower edge. Keep center of pitch mostly unobstructed.
Constraints: one coherent complete match-screen image, no comparison grid, no browser frame, no explanatory labels about architecture, no slogans, no fake photographic 3D models. Keep text minimal and legible. This is illustrative art, not rules-validated gameplay.

variants.name: Parallel grid · 55°
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise camera-view edit. Reference image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the Moles Under the Pitch default match-screen concept. References 2 and 3 are SITE STYLE references only. Create one full landscape screen.
CHANGE ONLY THE CAMERA/PROJECTION as specified: Change the pitch ground projection to an END-ON ORTHOGRAPHIC parallel projection, camera elevation 55 degrees, zero yaw. Both sidelines are vertical PARALLEL lines, NOT a trapezoid: the field must have the SAME width near and far. All grid tiles have the SAME apparent width and row height at all distances. Every player is the SAME apparent scale regardless of distance (retain original character art). Keep looking down the length with home in the near half and away in the far half. Field length can extend offscreen vertically.
INVARIANTS: same original pixel-art stadium, turf, chalk grid, mole branding, 11-versus-11 humans/orcs formation and kits, football, selected Alden, half 1 turn 4, score 1-0, team names, and same compact translucent navy/cyan/gold square HUD placement. Preserve crisp pixel character clusters and the SITE styling; no ornate MVP serif/brass UI. Make grass/grid details clearly visible through the HUD backgrounds, keep text/control glyphs fully opaque and readable. Do NOT make cosmetic color changes as a substitute for changing ground-camera geometry. Retain HOME VIEW label.
Output is one coherent reference screenshot, no contact sheet or architecture text.

limitations: Nominal angles are generation targets, not measured camera geometry.
Illustrative player positions/counts, grid geometry and actions may drift between concepts.
This batch does not revise team sprite standards or promote production sprites.
Panel translucency is illustrated in flattened image composites; production opacity and contrast require implementation checks.
